text: Payward, Inc. (d/b/a Kraken) is a private, Delaware-incorporated company. Per CoinDesk's reporting on its 2026 funding round toward a $20bn valuation, its investors include Jane Street, DRW Venture Capital, Tribe Capital and Citadel Securities (a separate $200m strategic investment); no state or state-fund investor is named.

source.name: CoinDesk: Crypto platform Kraken is raising capital at $20 billion valuation ahead of its planned IPO
source.quote: The round included backing from investors such as Jane Street, DRW Venture Capital and Tribe Capital, while Citadel Securities later agreed to a separate $200 million strategic investment
